home.eyebrow: THE BISTRO · THE WINE · THE COMPANY
home.title: The spirit
home.intro: French cooking, wines we love and the joy of being together. Your neighbourhood bistro, just a few steps from Parc Monceau.
home.storyText: Behind the red awning, tables draw close and conversation flows. At Le Phalsbourg, hospitality is a simple pleasure: good food, the right bottle and the joy of being together.
home.storyText2: Matthieu Fève and his team welcome you to a place where the care of fine dining meets the warmth of a Parisian bistro.
home.foodText: An Abondance cheese soufflé, gently seared fish, the comfort of rice pudding. Our menu follows the seasons and the pleasure of cooking with fresh ingredients.
home.wineText: Over 350 wines, from approachable discoveries to exceptional bottles. By the glass, the bottle or the magnum, our cellar invites you to explore.
home.quote: A new place with the feel of an old meeting place for friends.
home.privateText: A birthday, a team lunch or a wine tasting with friends. Bring together up to {capacity} guests in a bistro that knows how to make you feel welcome.
home.visitTitle: Shall we save you a table?
home.visitText: A leisurely lunch or an evening to enjoy. We look forward to welcoming you.

la-maison.title: The art of making you welcome.
la-maison.intro: A team shaped by exceptional establishments, brought together by their craft and a love of the traditional French bistro.
la-maison.storyTitle: From the cellar to the table.
la-maison.storyText: Trained at Médéric and Ferrandi Paris, Matthieu Fève learned about wine and French hospitality from Paris to Finistère, including at Les Botanistes and The Ritz. Opposite Parc Monceau, he transformed a former Italian restaurant into a traditional French bistro.
la-maison.storyText2: The same care goes into the food and the wine. Seasonal cooking and a cellar shaped by encounters with wine professionals define the spirit of Le Phalsbourg.

team.name: Matthieu Fève
team.text: A background in wine and hospitality, a passion for terroir and a desire to share his discoveries.

team.name: Ahmed Kawsar
team.text: After working at Alain Ducasse’s Spoon 2, Ahmed joined the adventure in its earliest days. Precision, generosity and care go into every plate.

team.name: Archibald Franquinet
team.text: Having worked at Père & Fish and Dada Bistrot in Courbevoie, Archibald brings warmth and attention to your choice of food and wine.

privatisation.title: Every reason to come together.
privatisation.intro: A warm setting, seasonal cooking and wines to share. Le Phalsbourg welcomes the moments that matter.
privatisation.detailText: A birthday, family gathering, wedding reception or company dinner: we will help shape an occasion around your wishes. Lunch, dinner or a wine tasting — tell us what you have in mind.
privatisation.location: A few steps from Parc Monceau
privatisation.contactText: Tell us your preferred date, the number of guests and what you have in mind. Our team will get back to you directly.

contact.title: A good address. A lovely time.
contact.intro: Find us at 3 rue de Phalsbourg, in Paris’s 17th arrondissement, just a few steps from Parc Monceau.

contact.reservationText: Choose your table through our Zenchef booking page, or give us a call.

presse.title: Words that mean a lot.
presse.intro: Restaurant reviews and happy discoveries: a few glimpses of life at Le Phalsbourg.
presse.pudloText: Le Phalsbourg appears in Gilles Pudlowski’s selection of the 150 best bistros in Paris.
presse.parisienText: Rémi Déchambre and Laurent Guez have written about Le Phalsbourg, including in Le Parisien Week-End and “Le Bistrot de la semaine”.
presse.laureText: Laure de Gramont shares her discovery of the restaurant in “Life is delicious at Le Phalsbourg”.
presse.recognitionText: Trophées Pudlo des Bistrots, Tables & Auberges de France and Collège Culinaire de France: recognition that encourages us to keep giving our best.
